newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says no rupiah depreciation target.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says no rupiah depreciation target.

text.p: Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjat Djiwandono said on Thursday he was not targetting an exact depreciation level for the rupiah.

"It is getting more complicated, we cannot use a simple, linear kind of thinking," Djiwandono said after being asked in an interview with Reuters Financial Television whether Bank Indonesia would maintain its five percent annual depreciation level.
"We are not working like mathematicians that it has to be exact," Djiwandono said in Tokyo.
"It is difficult for me to answer with a convincing one word.....because the issue is a complex issue and not just black and white."
Djiwandono said central banks in developing countries could not just concentrate on one issue such as inflation like their developed country counterparts.
"I believe that the financial and monetary sectors have to support and facilitate the real sectors," he said.
